meta.target: Whoosh 4.0.0 BLE client online and offline

confidence_levels.confirmed: directly follows from bytecode or string with file and line
confidence_levels.inferred: follows from code plus a stated platform or device assumption
confidence_levels.missing: not present in APK, required input listed

match_rule.fact: UUID converted to long, shifted right 32, compared with constants; only high 32 bits matter

full_128_bit_client_uuids.basis: Bluetooth SIG base UUID, code does not set full UUIDs

server_client_mismatch.fact: server profile uses SIG 181c and 2a57, client resolver compares 1c18 and 572a

short_key.fact: ByteString.Companion.d(16, bytes) copies first 16 bytes; array shorter than 16 throws

no_local_crypto.fact: response bleCommand is returned unchanged; class name Encryptor is misleading

write.payload: hex string from backend decoded by okio hex decoder

misleading_log.fact: write is still executed on attempt 10 at 278-293

retry.final_timeout_behavior: logs Final attempt timed out, then awaits the same deferred without timeout at 348-360; returns without error only on late success, throws CommandExecuteException on late error, may suspend indefinitely without response
retry.total_wait_note: no hard upper bound because of await without timeout after attempt 10

uuid.match_rule: same high 32 bits comparison as online

Unique id must be exactly 4 bytes in hex

write.total_timeout_message: Offline start command timed out after
write.timeout_log: Offline start write timed out on attempt
write.failure_log: Offline start write failed on attempt

write_primitive.behavior: requires CONNECTED, calls BleGattWrapper.b, throws on false

response.prefix_check: first three bytes equal 0xBB or 0xEE, helper checks indexes 0..2 and range

parsing.BBBBBB with status: status from byte[8], matched with BleOfflineStartStatus.getCode
parsing.BBBBBB without byte[8]: BleOfflineStartMalformedResponseException, IoT returned BBBBBB response without status byte valueHex=
parsing.STATUS_SCOOTER_ONLINE: BleOfflineStartFallbackToSmsException, IoT returned scooter online status statusByte=
parsing.other known: BleOfflineStartStatusException, IoT returned command status=, statusByte=, valueHex=
parsing.unknown: BleOfflineStartUnknownStatusException, IoT returned BBBBBB response with unknown status statusByte=
parsing.EEEEEE: BleOfflineStartErrorResultException, IoT returned EEEEEE response valueHex=
parsing.other: ignored, log ignored unsupported response format valueHex=

unrelated_to_scooter_commands.basis: no calls from online or offline scooter sessions

corrections_to_report_whoosh.old: command encoded as UTF-8 and written to 0x9f2a
corrections_to_report_whoosh.new: command is a hex string from backend, decoded by decodeHex into bytes; UTF-8 used only for notify response

corrections_to_report_whoosh.old: response awaited up to 3 times by 500 ms
corrections_to_report_whoosh.new: 10 writes, each with up to 1500 ms wait; 3 by 500 ms is pollUntilSuccess of digital_output inside an attempt
no pause between online attempts; 500 ms is poll interval and key polling interval

corrections_to_report_whoosh.old: 3 s write timeout is the command response timeout
corrections_to_report_whoosh.new: 3 s is the GATT write ack timeout; response wait is 1500 ms per attempt

corrections_to_report_whoosh.old: timeout of the last attempt counts as an error
corrections_to_report_whoosh.new: timeout on attempt 10 logs, then awaits the same deferred without timeout; no error only on late success, otherwise CommandExecuteException or indefinite wait
client compares only high 32 bits; full 128-bit values are inferred from SIG base UUID
offline uses 0xE018, 0xDD1A, 0xDD2A, payload commandId + attempt + token and BBBBBB statuses
